reason: E1 confirms Mo is a beta stabilizer with solid solution strengthening in Ti alloys, but neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence that Mo forms coherent precipitates in Ti-Ni-primary HEAs or that such precipitates improve creep resistance; the precipitation and creep improvement premises are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Mo is a beta stabilizer in Ti alloys and provides strong solid solution strengthening
Mo promotes formation of coherent precipitates in Ti- and Ni-primary HEAs
Mo-induced precipitates and lattice distortion impede dislocation motion and grain boundary sliding at high temperature
Mo addition enhances elevated-temperature yield strength and creep resistance in such HEAs
